browse.title: Browse
browse.description: Helios iNuvio browse (endpoint) to extract. Click the button to load available browses.

output_table_name.title: Output Table Name
output_table_name.description: Name for the output table in Keboola Storage. Defaults to browse_<ident> when left empty.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Columns to extract. Leave empty to extract all columns.

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Required for incremental load (enables upsert). Select columns that uniquely identify each row.

filter.title: Filter (Advanced)
filter.description: Optional server-side condition selecting which records to return, over column system names Table.Field (e.g. TabCisOrg.ID). Empty returns all rows. For the syntax, see the HELIOS iNuvio Server System API docs.
